units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 2:5">Ex. R. s. 2</cite>; Tanḥ. Sh’moth 14 (expl. <he>בלבת</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 3:2">Ex. III, 2</cite>) <he>משני חלקיו של ס׳</he> (from the heart of) from upward of two thirds of the height of the thorn-bush.

<cite ref="Exodus 3:2">Ib.</cite> <he>הם … אף אני בס׳ וכ׳</he> they (the Israelites) are in anguish, I (the Lord) also appear in the thorn-bush, out of a narrow place. Ex. R. l. c. <he>מה הסנה שפל וכ׳</he> as the thorn-bush is the lowest of the trees, so are the Israelites &c.; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="O01163"><he>סְנָאִים</he></cite>, <cite ref="O01163"><he>סְנָאִין</he></cite>, <cite ref="O01163"><he>סְנָיִים</he></cite>, <cite ref="O01163"><he>סְנָיִין</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 8:5">Kil. VIII, 5</cite>, a. e. <he>חוּלְדַּת הס׳</he>, v. <cite ref="H00330"><he>חוּלְדָּה</he> I</cite>. Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 2 <cite ref="O00132"><he>סגיין</he></cite> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 117a">B. Mets. 117ᵃ</cite> (expl. <cite ref="V00912"><he>תקרה</he></cite>) <he>קינים ס׳ וטינא</he> Ar. (ed. <he>קינים וס׳</he>) he must furnish reeds, thorns and clay (for the ceiling).—
